name: Washing Machine Repair
description: Not draining, not spinning, leaking or throwing an error code. The expert inspects it and quotes the repair before touching anything.

process.title: Inspection
process.body: The technician runs the washing machine through the fault you described and finds what is actually causing it.

process.title: Quote
process.body: Whatever is needed beyond the visit is written up — part and labour separately — and nothing starts until you approve it.

process.title: Repair
process.body: Only what you approved. Parts we fit are ours, and they carry the service warranty with the labour.

process.title: Test and clean up
process.body: The washing machine is run again in front of you, and the area is left as it was found.

excludes: Spare parts. Anything needed is quoted on site and charged separately.
Any fault other than the one this visit was booked for, unless you approve it.
Appliances still under manufacturer warranty, where a third-party repair may void it — check with them first.
Commercial or industrial appliances.

faqs.q: Does the price include spare parts?
faqs.a: No. ₹299 covers the visit and the inspection. Any part the job needs is quoted on site, itemised with its labour, and nothing is ordered or fitted until you approve it.

faqs.q: What if I do not want the repair after the quote?
faqs.a: Then nothing happens beyond the visit. You pay the visit fee for the inspection and the technician leaves — there is no pressure and no cancellation charge at that point.

faqs.q: What if the same fault comes back?
faqs.a: Every completed job carries a 30-day service warranty on the work and the parts we supplied. While it is valid, a return visit for the same fault costs nothing.

faqs.q: Who is coming to my home?
faqs.a: A technician on our own roster, not a marketplace of strangers. Their name, photo and rating are on the booking before they arrive, and they cannot start until you read out the code on that screen.

faqs.q: How do I pay?
faqs.a: Card, UPI or netbanking through our payment provider, or after the service where that is offered. Every booking ends with a GST invoice you can download.
